name: email-dashboard
description: A local, private triage board for your own mail. An agent sweeps your mailboxes on a schedule; this is where the result lives - what was binned and why, what was kept, what needs you. Messages open in a sandboxed reader that strips scripts and blocks every remote image, so a tracking pixel never fires. Learns which hosts each sender normally links to and flags one writing from somewhere new. Ships with no mailboxes: you add your own.
